Class AnahataConfigurable

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.settings.AnahataConfigurable
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.intellij.openapi.options.Configurable, com.intellij.openapi.options.UnnamedConfigurable
public class AnahataConfigurable extends Object implements com.intellij.openapi.options.Configurable
A native Settings page (Settings → Tools → Anahata ASI) for the plugin defaults.

Edits the persisted AnahataSettings — the default provider and model applied to newly created sessions. Deeper, per-session configuration remains available through the tool window's Preferences action.

anahata
